work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #vm_af5_hc_d"))
work_conn.execute(text("""
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA, t1.[AÑO], t1.TRIM, t1.SECTOR, t1.C_CAGENTE, t1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_ENTRADA, t1.C_SCN, t1.N_SCN, 'VM' AS FUENTE, '0300' AS PROC,
       SUM((t1.DATO * t2.RATIO) - t1.DATO) AS DATO
INTO #vm_af5_hc_d
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
INNER JOIN #ratio_inv_hc_c t2
    ON t1.[AÑO] = t2.[AÑO] AND t1.TRIM = t2.TRIM AND t1.SECTOR = t2.SECTOR
   AND t1.C_CAGENTE = t2.C_CAGENTE AND t1.C_ENTRADA = t2.C_ENTRADA
   AND t1.C_CUENTA = t2.C_CUENTA AND t1.C_SCN = t2.C_SCN
GROUP BY t1.[AÑO], t1.TRIM, t1.SECTOR, t1.C_CAGENTE, t1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_ENTRADA, t1.C_SCN, t1.N_SCN
"""))

       SUM(CASE WHEN C_CUENTA = 'Bce Inicio' THEN DATO * -1 ELSE DATO END) AS DATO
INTO #vm_af5_hc_rp

"""))

# AGRUPA TABLA ANTERIOR CON BALANCES A VALOR LIBRO — LEFT(PUT(SECTOR,CHAR5.)) es el SECTOR numérico convertido a texto sin ceros de relleno (CAST a varchar en SQL Server produce el mismo texto que LEFT/PUT+CHAR sin blancos)
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ag_af5_hc_p"))
work_conn.execute(text("""
SELECT MONEDA, [AÑO], TRIM,
       TRY_CAST(C_CAGENTE AS float) AS SECTOR,
       CAST(SECTOR AS varchar(5)) AS C_CAGENTE,
       C_CUENTA, 'D' AS C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
INTO #ag_af5_hc_p
FROM #vm_af5_hc_p_all
GROUP BY MONEDA, [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN
"""))
